lead.title: FAA Approves Long-Range Drone Flight to Offshore Oil Platform
lead.summary: The FAA authorized Skyways to conduct a beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) drone flight from Gibson, Louisiana, to an offshore Shell platform in the Gulf of Mexico. The agency described the approval as its first authorization for a BVLOS drone operation originating from the U.S. coastline and extending over the Gulf.

leads.summary: Venti Technologies is operating approximately 60 fully autonomous container trucks 24/7 in intermodal yards across California and Texas. The company, which describes its software system as costing roughly $70 million to $80 million, has agreements with several Class I railroads and expects significant rail-yard volume to materialize in two years.

leads.title: Army fields launched effects to 11 of 12 divisions, with Griffon Aerospace delivering the majority
leads.summary: The Army has fielded launched effects to 11 of its 12 headquarters divisions, with Griffon Aerospace supplying the majority of the systems. The service plans to start providing the 12th and final division with launched effects next month.

stories.title: Quantum Cyber Expands and Secures Exclusive Quantum Photonic Array License, Extending Its Quantum Layer Across Air, Surface and Subsea Unmanned Warfare Domains
stories.summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. executed an amendment to its intellectual property license with Project LightShift, expanding exclusive rights to cover unmanned surface vessels, unmanned underwater vehicles, and related maritime systems. The agreement, signed by subsidiary Quantum Drones Corporation, extends the quantum photonic array license beyond unmanned aerial vehicles to include dedicated infrastructure for detection, tracking, and control across air, surface, and subsea domains.

stories.title: Kongsberg, Navantia ink MoU on autonomous underwater vehicles
stories.summary: Kongsberg and Navantia signed a Memorandum of Understanding to integrate HUGIN autonomous underwater vehicles into conventional submarines and develop advanced sonar technologies. The agreement aims to enhance anti-submarine warfare capabilities and ensure compliance with Spanish Navy and NATO operational standards.

stories.title: Kazakhstan – Uzbekistan freight railway opens to relieve border crossing
stories.summary: Freight trains began using the Darbaza – Maktaaral railway in the Turkistan region, a 286bn tenge project built to provide an alternative route to Uzbekistan and relieve congestion on the main Saryagash – Toshkent corridor.

stories.title: Swiss company Xer Technologies launches X12 hybrid naval drone for naval surveillance and tactical resupply
stories.summary: Swiss manufacturer Xer Technologies AG introduced its updated X12 heavy-duty hybrid-electric naval drone at Euronaval 2026 in Paris. The 70 kg maximum takeoff weight VTOL multicopter combines a 30 kg payload capacity, 7+ hour flight endurance, and a heavy-fuel engine designed for shipboard integration without gasoline fire risks.

stories.title: Skydio launches Controller 2 with a brighter screen and 5G
stories.summary: Skydio began shipping Controller 2, a handheld controller for its X10, X10D, and R10 drones that features a 7-inch, 2,000-nit touchscreen and swappable 5G SIM card support. The device offers approximately 5 hours and 45 minutes of operating time, an IP55 rating, and 128GB of internal storage, with a dedicated Microhard radio version available for X10D operators.

stories.title: European Parliament Committees Propose EU-Wide Rules for Automated Driving Testing and Deployment
stories.summary: The European Parliament’s Environment, Internal Market, and Transport Committees adopted a Joint Committee Report on November 4, 2026, proposing EU-wide rules to harmonize testing and deployment of automated vehicles. The report introduces mutual recognition of national authorizations and an “intermediate type-approval” for commercial pre-deployment, with Parliament’s plenary tentatively scheduled to vote on its negotiating mandate in mid-December 2026.

stories.title: MiGs for anti-drone systems. An agreement between Poland and Ukraine
stories.summary: Poland agreed to transfer two MiG-29 aircraft to Ukraine in exchange for anti-drone technologies, a deal Minister Cezary Tomczyk described as close to finalization. Poland has also committed to a 50 million euro military donation and has previously transferred 14 MiG-29 jets and over 45 formal donation packages worth approximately 16.5 billion zloty.

stories.title: ACS opens laser division amid counter-drone boom
Electra Defense Receives $4.7 Million US Air Force Contract for EL9 Testing
40% of trains cancelled, over 4,000 passengers affected as Spanish drivers strike after two fatal crashes
stories.summary: Spanish train drivers struck on Tuesday, cancelling 40% of long- and medium-distance services and affecting 4,042 passengers, following two fatal crashes on the Madrid-Seville line this year. The union demanded increased investment in maintenance and safety after talks with the government broke down in April.

stories.title: VisionWave (Nasdaq: VWAV) Adds Six Field-Tested, Commercially Available Unmanned Aerial Systems to Its STRATUM Aerial Portfolio
stories.summary: VisionWave Holdings added six field-tested unmanned aerial systems to its STRATUM portfolio on Nov. 10, 2026, covering surveillance, logistics, and counter-drone operations. The company has not received purchase orders or recognized revenue from these platforms, and their sale remains subject to export-control authorizations.

stories.title: PteroDynamics Targets European Defense Partnerships to Expand Military UAS Opportunities
stories.summary: PteroDynamics Inc. is participating in the 2026 Transatlantic Defense Industry Access Forum, held November 9–12 in Poland and Italy, to explore opportunities for its Transwing unmanned aircraft system in European defense operations. The company is engaging NATO allies and defense industry leaders to evaluate how autonomous vertical takeoff and landing aircraft could support military logistics and resupply missions.

stories.title: Figure AI is hiring a human to babysit humanoid robots overnight
stories.summary: Figure AI is hiring a night-shift coordinator in Santa Clara to oversee its humanoid robots, a contract-to-hire role paying $40 to $45 an hour from 10:30 p.m. to 7 a.m. The position entails scheduling and coaching the team, troubleshooting robot failures and safety issues, and sometimes operating the machines themselves.

stories.title: GE Aerospace and BETA Complete Hybrid-Electric Assisted Takeoff Test
Michael Healander joins Commercial Drone Alliance board of directors
stories.summary: Michael Healander, Co-Founder, President and CEO of Airspace Link, joined the Commercial Drone Alliance’s board of directors. The alliance stated that Healander brings 25 years of leadership experience working with defence, government agencies, and commercial aviation operators.

stories.title: Matternet and Swisslog Healthcare team up to bring drone delivery to hospitals
stories.summary: Matternet and Swisslog Healthcare’s TransLogic division partnered to connect autonomous drone deliveries with existing automated hospital transport systems. The first year of the partnership will focus on bringing drone delivery to hospital systems in California, Florida, and Arizona using Matternet’s M3 drone delivery platform.

stories.title: WSDOT Opens Public Input on $42bn Cascadia High Speed Rail Project Linking Three Regions
stories.summary: The Washington State Department of Transportation opened public input on a $24 billion to $42 billion high-speed rail project linking Vancouver, B.C., Seattle, and Portland. WSDOT will review the concept until the end of 2028, with estimates suggesting the line could transport 1.3 to 1.7 million passengers.

stories.title: Rheinmetall’s Skyranger to protect Belgian critical infrastructure from drones
stories.summary: The Rheinmetall Group secured a contract to supply 20 Skyranger 30 systems to Belgium for the stationary protection of critical infrastructure from drones. Delivery is scheduled to begin at the end of 2028, and the systems will integrate into the Belgian ‘Blue Dome’ layered air defence programme.

stories.title: SESAR JU and ESA to jointly integrate space tech to support new airspace entrants
stories.summary: The SESAR Joint Undertaking (SESAR JU) and the European Space Agency (ESA) signed a memorandum of cooperation to accelerate the integration of space-enabled technologies into the future Digital European Sky. The parties will assess how European space programmes and infrastructure, including IRIS², Galileo and EGNOS, can strengthen airspace traffic management in Europe.

stories.title: Harmattan AI, Barzan Explore New Counter-Drone Capabilities for Qatar
stories.summary: Harmattan AI and Barzan Holdings signed a memorandum of understanding to explore deploying autonomous very short-range air defense systems in Qatar. The partnership will demonstrate Harmattan AI’s GOBI TEMPEST platform, a mid-range counter-drone interceptor designed for Group 2 and Group 3 aerial threats.

stories.title: Denmark's Lokaltog places first order for Stadler RS Zero railcar
stories.summary: Lokaltog selected Stadler to supply four RS Zero battery railcars for the Jægersborg – Nærum line north of København, marking the first commercial tender selection for the type. The trains are expected to enter service from 2031.

also.title: Stadler Secures First European Order for RS ZERO Battery Trains from Lokaltog

stories.title: New U-space ConOps supports next phase of drone integration in Europe
stories.summary: The SESAR Joint Undertaking’s CORUS Five project published the fifth edition of the U-space Concept of Operations, outlining how drone flights can be organized in busy airspace. The document details three time horizons for integration, notes that initial deployments may require external or public funding, and states that urgent flights should receive priority.

stories.title: Hartford Line service adds New Haven-Hartford trains Nov. 16
stories.summary: The Connecticut Department of Transportation announced that CTrail will add a weekday New Haven-Hartford round trip on November 16, increasing service to 11 northbound and 12 southbound trains. The new northbound train No. 4456 leaves New Haven Union Station at 12:50 p.m., while the return trip No. 4455 departs Hartford at 3 p.m.

stories.title: Uber’s AV Labs Chief to Leave on Same Day as Its Head of Autonomous
stories.summary: Uber Vice President of Engineering and Science Danny Guo is leaving on November 16, the same day as global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia. Guo, who reports to Chief Technology Officer Praveen Neppalli Naga, is taking a role outside the transportation industry. His departure occurs weeks before Uber plans to begin fully driverless testing of its robotaxi with Lucid and Nuro.

stories.title: Volz Servos contribute to Singapore’s first indigenous eVTOL
stories.summary: Researchers at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) flew the first eVTOL aircraft completely designed, engineered, and built in Singapore. The 8-meter wingspan demonstrator, equipped with Volz Servos actuators, reached heights above 90 meters during a month-long test campaign in Summer 2026 at the DLR National Experimental Test Center for Unmanned Aircraft Systems in Germany.

stories.title: Valkyrie Dynamics Raises €1M for All-Weather Drone Radar
stories.summary: Valkyrie Dynamics raised €1M in a pre-seed round led by Hexa to develop a 100-gram radar seeker for low-cost drones. The company plans to use the funds for manufacturing, next-generation development, and team expansion, with European technical integration hubs planned for late 2026.

also.title: From sleeping on a Kyiv factory floor to €1M funding: Valkyrie Dynamics takes on drone warfare
Valkyrie Dynamics raises €1M for a miniature radar seeker that lets interceptor drones hunt in any weather

stories.title: Why Is the Robot as a Service (RaaS) Market Becoming a High-Growth Investment Opportunity Amid Rising Demand f
stories.summary: DataM Intelligence valued the global Robot as a Service market at USD 2.60 billion in 2025, projecting it will reach USD 12.84 billion by 2035. The report attributes this 18% compound annual growth rate to rising demand for flexible automation and reduced upfront capital expenditure.

stories.title: Russian governor confirms industrial site damaged in Novgorod drone attack
stories.summary: The Novgorod regional governor confirmed that a drone attack overnight on Nov. 10 damaged an industrial site and two vacation homes, with no casualties reported. Ukrainian monitoring channels reported explosions near the 123rd Aircraft Repair Plant in Staraya Russa, a facility that services Russian military transport aircraft, though independent confirmation of damage to the plant remains lacking.

stories.title: Amazon takes major step towards UK expansion of drone delivery service
stories.summary: Amazon secured the world’s first Sail 4 operating authorisation from the Civil Aviation Authority, enabling Prime Air drone deliveries to around 8,000 households in the Darlington area starting Tuesday. This expansion allows drones to fly across urban areas, increasing access from the previous 600 pilot customers.

Amazon Secures UK Regulatory Clearance for Drone Trials

stories.title: World Bank: Robotics Adoption Mitigates GDP Losses from Labor Shortages in Advanced Economies
stories.summary: The World Bank published a September 2026 study indicating that robotics adoption mitigates GDP losses from labor shortages in advanced economies. The analysis projects that doubling robot productivity by 2035 would narrow China's projected GDP loss from 5.6% to 4.9%, while reducing the aggregate GDP loss across 46 developed nations from 2.3% to 1.9%.

stories.title: Fact Check: Viral post featuring Taiwan’s bullet train falsely shared as an Indian train
stories.summary: Fact-checkers determined that viral images and videos of the N700ST high-speed train are from Taiwan, not India. The footage shows the first of 12 new N700ST trainsets ordered from Japan being unloaded at the Port of Kaohsiung, contradicting claims that the images depict India's Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor.

stories.title: Drones attacked the occupied cities of Donetsk and Luhansk, Berdyansk, and regions of Russia; there are widespread power outages
stories.summary: On the night of November 10, drones attacked the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine and a number of regions in Russia. The strikes caused widespread power outages in Donetsk and Luhansk.

stories.title: Moskva aims for 90% of its tram fleet to be driverless by 2035
stories.summary: Moskva plans to expand driverless tram operations to two additional routes by the end of this year, targeting 90% of its fleet to be equipped with the technology by 2035.

also.title: Moskva to Expand Driverless Tram Service to Two More Routes by End of 2026

stories.title: ASEAN in the global robotics value chain and prospects for Vietnam-Malaysia cooperation.
stories.summary: Samirul Ariff Othman, a policy analyst at Global Asia Consulting, advised that Malaysia and Vietnam should initiate substantive commercial cooperation to build a high-value robotics ecosystem. He proposed four pillars, including business-led research, product development, workforce training, and a network linking bilateral testing facilities, to help the region retain a greater share of added value from the smart technology revolution.

stories.title: VESSEL REVIEW | Vanta 12 – German-designed modular USV for strike and reconnaissance
stories.summary: Berlin-based Stark Defence unveiled its Vanta 12 unmanned surface vehicle on September 28, 2026, designed to carry MBDA's Sea Venom anti-ship missile and Cascade loitering munition. The 12-metre craft, which participated in NATO REPMUS 2026 exercises, is slated for production in the hundreds per year under agreements with Danish and German shipyards.

stories.title: US Marines Seek New Extended-Range Cargo Drones

also.title: U.S. Marines Train with Neros Archer FPV Attack Drones to Extend Infantry Strike Range

stories.title: MARINA holds forum on seafarer training for AI, autonomous ships
stories.summary: The Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) is examining whether simulator-based training can partially replace seagoing service and what skills Filipino seafarers need to operate maritime autonomous surface ships (MASS). These topics were among four studies presented at a MARINA research forum on Monday, Nov. 9, 2026.

stories.title: LMT Defence, Thales join forces to advance counter-drone technologies in Europe
stories.summary: LMT Defence and Thales Italia signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore drone detection using mobile network infrastructure and defense 4G/5G technologies. The agreement allows the companies to evaluate combining LMT products with Thales Italia’s solutions to track drones via behavioral patterns, with the potential to progress towards a proof of concept subject to mutual agreement.

stories.title: ‘Fundamentally different’: NATO tests 400-drone battlefield as military threats intensify
stories.summary: NATO conducted a two-week exercise in Latvia involving more than 30 countries and 100 industrial partners, culminating in a scenario with almost 400 drones. Simultaneously, the Royal Navy launched Nyan Maritime attack drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth, marking the first time strike drones took off from a British carrier.

stories.title: Foreign Tier 1 Suppliers Begin "Selling Scenarios" to Robotics Companies
stories.summary: Aptiv signed cooperation agreements with Tars and Shanghai Electric at the China International Import Expo. Tars revealed plans to deploy hundreds of A-series robots by the end of 2026, covering eight major production processes and 33 application scenarios.

stories.title: Bullet Train Project: Overhead Wires on Surat–Bilimora Section to Be Energised from November 20
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited announced that overhead electrical wires on the Surat–Bilimora section of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project will be energised on or after November 20, 2026. The corporation warned the public to treat all overhead wires as live from that date and cautioned against approaching the installations to prevent accidents.

stories.title: ADF down 135 of 162 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
stories.summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 135 of 162 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since the evening of November 9. The attack included one Iskander-M ballistic missile and 162 Shahed-type attack drones, with hits recorded at 19 locations and four people injured in Kharkiv.

stories.title: Cowin Robotics wins robot system order from global ESS company
stories.summary: Cowin Robotics won a new order for a robot integration system from an unnamed global energy storage system company on Nov. 10. The system will be deployed at the customer’s mid- to large-sized ESS manufacturing line, expanding robot use to battery pack manufacturing and inspection processes.

stories.title: Robotic Car Charger Locks On With Suction
stories.summary: Mew463 built a low-profile robotic car charger that uses two suction cups to anchor itself to the vehicle while a gear assembly pushes the charger home. The robot uses API calls to remotely unlock the charge port and relies on four Mecanum wheels, LiDAR, and an onboard camera with a ChARuco board pattern for precise alignment.

stories.title: SNCF Voyageurs signs Île-de-France commuter train operating contract
stories.summary: Île-de-France Mobilités signed a directly awarded contract for SNCF Voyageurs to operate Transilien suburban services in 2026-30. The agreement includes higher requirements for several performance indicators.

stories.title: Gumi City Visits China's Humanoid Industry Site...Looking to enter the robot manufacturing supply chain
stories.summary: Gumi City Mayor Kim Jang-ho led a delegation to Beijing and Shanghai from the 9th to the 12th to examine humanoid robot mass production and certification systems. The city aims to connect local electronics and semiconductor capabilities to the global robot supply chain, focusing on core parts development and mass production methods.

also.title: Gumi Officials Tour China's Robot Hubs to Expand Manufacturing Into Humanoids

stories.title: Epson AX6 collaborative robot weighs just 17 kg and works right next to human factory crews
stories.summary: Epson launched the AX6 collaborative robot in Southeast Asia, featuring a 17 kg body and ISO Class 5 cleanroom classification. The unit operates on AC and DC power, includes hand-guided teaching, and allows human workers to share the workspace safely.

stories.title: Russian Drone Attacks Threaten Ukraine Rail Travel
stories.summary: Human Rights Watch reported that Russian drone attacks on Ukrainian trains killed and injured civilians, including railway workers, and threatened a transportation system millions depend on. Oleksandr Shevchenko, deputy head of passenger services at Ukrzaliznytsia, stated that Russian forces damaged or destroyed more than 500 locomotives since 2022, including more than 300 in 2026 alone.

stories.title: Wing makes a $125 million bet on U.S. drone manufacturing
stories.summary: Alphabet-owned Wing announced a $125 million investment over the next two years to build a 15,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Fort Worth, Texas, capable of producing tens of thousands of aircraft annually and creating up to 100 jobs.

stories.title: CDG autonomous vehicle stops in yellow box in Punggol, company adjusting software after incident
stories.summary: ComfortDelGro is adjusting the software of one of its autonomous vehicles after it stopped within a yellow box on Northshore Drive in Punggol. The company stated that its onboard safety operator flagged the matter and is improving the vehicle's handling of junctions to comply with traffic rules.

stories.title: Nvidia Details South Korean Projects for Factories, Robots and Self-Driving
stories.summary: Nvidia announced partnerships with Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics, and Kakao Mobility for physical AI projects in South Korea. The initiatives include digital twins for semiconductor factories, robot training simulations, and a Level 4 autonomous-driving system for Kia PBV vehicles.

stories.title: Army small drone crashes in Gimpo during training; probe to focus on comms loss
stories.summary: An Army small unmanned aerial vehicle crashed near a training site in Gimpo, Gyeonggi, after losing communications. Army spokesperson Bae Seok-jin stated the unit retrieved the damaged airframe after a resident reported it, and the Army is investigating why communications were lost and how the aircraft left the training area.

also.title: (LEAD) Military drone crashes in Gimpo; no civilian damage reported: Army
A military drone that was training at Gimpo Park crashed...No casualties

stories.title: Turkey Shows Ukraine TOLGA Anti-Drone Defense System
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials led by Pavel Palisa visited a Turkish testing ground where MKE demonstrated the TOLGA anti-drone system, which features 20mm cannons capable of firing 3,200 rounds per minute. MKE indicated readiness to supply the system to Kiev, though no contract has been announced.

stories.title: Good news for passengers as Indian Railways set to run special train between Lucknow and Mumbai; check stoppages and fares
stories.summary: Indian Railways will operate a one-way reserved festival special train from Lucknow to Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (Mumbai) on Tuesday, departing at 9:45 pm and arriving at 3:35 am the following day. The train, numbered 04258, will include 20 coaches across AC, sleeper, and general categories to address rising passenger rush during the festive season.

stories.title: North Dakota Advanced Air Mobility and Drone Survey Tallies 27 Entities, About $159.5 Million in Committed Funding
stories.summary: A survey updated November 8, 2026, lists 27 North Dakota advanced air mobility entities with about $159.5 million in committed funding. The update adds Project RuralReach, a federally funded University of North Dakota drone trial that included a medical delivery flight from Williston to Watford City on July 24, 2025.

stories.title: China's GJ-11 Stealth Drone Lost Its Target in Cloud, Then Hit It
stories.summary: China’s state broadcaster CCTV aired new footage of the GJ-11 stealth combat drone on Monday, showing its internal weapon bays and confirming it hit a target in its first live-fire test after thick cloud obscured the initial pass. The report, part of a countdown to the 77th anniversary of the People’s Liberation Army Air Force, did not specify when the test occurred or which weapon was fired.

also.title: [VIDEO] China Reports First GJ-11 Stealth Drone Strike, Raising Stakes for Taiwan
China reveals new details of GJ-11 stealth combat drone in official footage

stories.title: Nagoya Station for Maglev Line to Be Completed in 2033 or Later
stories.summary: Central Japan Railway Co. officials said the new Nagoya Station for the maglev line is expected to be completed in 2033 or later. The company plans to announce a new opening schedule within this year after giving up its original 2027 target.

also.title: Maglev construction at Nagoya Station won’t be completed until at least 2033

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Cybercab Near Disney World Nov 9, No Park Access
stories.summary: Attractions Magazine staff photographed a gold two-seat Tesla Cybercab testing near Walt Disney World Resort on Interstate 4 on November 9, 2026. Tesla has not confirmed passenger service in the area, and its current limited Robotaxi service in Orlando excludes the theme parks and airport.

stories.title: LG Electronics tests CLOiD robot at washing machine factory using Nvidia AI
stories.summary: LG Electronics presented its CLOiD robot training process at Nvidia AI Day Seoul 2026, demonstrating how it uses Nvidia's GR00T model to hang 4-kg washing machine top panels. The company raised its robot training data target from 100,000 hours to 500,000 hours.

stories.title: Community leaders say new environmental study of Amtrak’s proposed South Side facility ‘woefully inadequate’
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration released a 59-page environmental assessment of Amtrak’s proposed $915 million maintenance facility near Rate Field, a move Ald. Nicole Lee and Cook County Commissioner John Daley called “woefully insufficient.” The agency opened a 30-day public comment period ending December 7, while Amtrak scheduled two public meetings in early December to discuss the document.

also.title: Amtrak Chicago maintenance facility assessment glosses over challenges: Analysis

stories.title: Bulgaria Reports Discovery of Human Remains on Ship Hit by Drone
stories.summary: Bulgarian officials confirmed the discovery of severely damaged human remains aboard the Wine Trader, a tanker struck by drones off Romania's coast on October 15. The Varna District Prosecutor’s Office ordered DNA testing to identify the deceased, while Bulgarian media reported that six of the seven missing seafarers were likely located on the vessel.

stories.title: China's EHang unveils EH216-EK firefighting eVTOL
stories.summary: EHang unveiled the EH216-EK firefighting eVTOL at its Wencheng Smart Manufacturing Center, featuring a 12-channel release system for 10-kilogram or 20-kilogram extinguishing canisters. The aircraft, with a 620-kilogram maximum takeoff weight, completed an on-site demonstration flight to showcase precision suppression capabilities for early-stage fires.

stories.title: Group walking 100 kilometres to Ottawa raising concerns over Alto high-speed rail project
stories.summary: A group is walking 100 kilometres to Ottawa to raise concerns over the Alto high-speed rail project.

stories.title: Russia Threatens Japanese Drone Manufacturer Terra Drone with Attacks
stories.summary: Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova threatened to attack Terra Drone's Ukrainian production facilities on October 21, following the company's October 14 announcement that its subsidiary Kulin delivered interceptor drones to the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense. Terra Drone CEO Toru Tokushige stated the company produces more than 12,000 interceptor drones annually and proposed mandatory requirements for domestic value creation in government procurement.

stories.title: The U.S. is drawing on Ukraine's experience in the use of relay drones
In First, Two CCAs Fly Air Combat Maneuvers Using Autonomy Software
stories.summary: Shield AI announced Nov. 9 that two FQ-44A drones flew air combat maneuvers coordinated by Hivemind autonomy software in a test Oct. 26 at the Nevada Test and Training Range. Shield AI vice president Todd Wesley said the test was a success and the company plans to add more assets and complexity to future exercises.

also.title: Shield AI’s Hivemind Enables U.S. Air Force Drones to Fly Coordinated Air Combat Maneuvers for the First Time

stories.title: Ukrainian Tech Team Develops Pocket Weather Station to Help Turrets Hit FPV Drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian engineers developed Strilets Core, a 234-gram portable weather station with an offline ballistic computer to help turrets intercept FPV drones. The device passed laboratory testing at Dnipro Technical College of Radio Electronics and is now seeking investment for production-ready field testing.

stories.title: An underwater combat drone weighing more than 11 tons and over 30 feet long was just put under contract for the French Navy, designed to fly in on a cargo plane, slip off a pier or a warship and run long missions on its own under human supervision, and onl
stories.summary: The French defense ministry’s innovation agency (AID) signed a contract with Naval Group to build an operational demonstrator of its Unmanned Combat Underwater Vehicle, or UCUV, for the French Navy. The agency announced the deal the next day. It says the drone has to be air-transportable, has to go into the water from a quay or a surface ship, and has to make a lot of its own decisions once it’s down there.

stories.title: Autonomous-driving pilot vehicles to reach 3,000 next year... Europe urges unified rules, saying “business viability is key”
stories.summary: The government plans to increase autonomous-driving pilot vehicles to at least 3,000 next year and revise Level 4 safety standards. European automakers urged Korea to adopt UN international standards, stating that differing regulations from country to country are hampering wider adoption.

stories.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL
stories.summary: NVIDIA introduced GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at the Conference on Robot Learning in Austin, Texas. The company announced an investment in South Korean startup Point2 and revealed that partners like Foxconn and Siemens are testing the new technologies for factory automation and industrial use cases.

stories.title: WMATA Plans December Rail Work, Single Tracking on Three Lines
stories.summary: The Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) will conduct rail work from Dec. 18–30, with service changes planned on the Green, Orange, Silver and Blue lines. Green Line trains will single-track between U Street and Georgia Avenue-Petworth from Dec. 18-30, while Orange and Silver line trains will single-track between McPherson Square and Smithsonian from Dec. 20-30.

stories.title: YYForce’s Humanoid Robotics and VLA Training Workflow Featured on Mediacorp’s Meeting AI
stories.summary: Mediacorp aired a feature on November 6, 2026, showcasing YYForce's humanoid robotics training workflow. The broadcast demonstrated the Unitree G1 robot learning to grasp and move a cup after 40 human demonstrations and eight hours of Vision-Language-Action model training.

stories.title: New Footage Shows China’s First Unmanned Stealth Fighters in Frontline Service
stories.summary: Newly released footage of China’s GJ-11 Sharp Sword unmanned stealth fighters has offered a rare look at the aircraft’s internal weapon bays. The Chinese People’s Liberation Army Air Force confirmed its first known deployment of GJ-11 at Shigatse Air Base in Tibet in October 2025.

stories.title: How autonomous vehicles are changing oilsands mining
stories.summary: Autonomous vehicles are increasingly present in many oilsands operations, impacting safety, productivity and jobs.

stories.title: Robotic Additive Manufacturing Uses Continuous Beech Veneer to Reinforce
stories.summary: Architectural researchers demonstrated a robotic additive manufacturing process that deposits continuous beech veneer along calculated principal stress lines to structurally reinforce lightweight timber slabs. The team used an ABB IRB4600 robotic arm to apply reactive polyurethane hot-melt adhesives, achieving a 433 percent relative improvement in joint tightness compared to manual fabrication.

stories.title: FAA Grants First Authorization for BVLOS Drone Operations Over Gulf
stories.summary: The FAA issued the first authorization for a drone to fly beyond the operator’s visual line of sight over the Gulf on November 9, 2026. Skyways will fly its autonomous V2 aircraft from a Shell facility in Gibson, La., to an offshore platform to conduct a pipeline inspection and simulated equipment delivery.

stories.summary: Ukraine's Southern Defense Forces announced on Nov. 9 that a joint operation struck a Russian "Rubicon" drone unit base in the occupied city of Berdyansk, Zaporizhzhia Oblast. The attack, which occurred on Nov. 7, targeted a temporary deployment point and drone control point located 107 kilometers behind the front lines.

stories.title: Autonomous EV developer Humble Robotics adds $51M to expand
stories.summary: Humble Robotics raised $51 million in Series A financing led by Obvious Ventures, bringing its total funding to $75 million. The company will use the capital for customer pilots, testing, early manufacturing, and expanding its platform to handle 40-foot containers and 53-foot dry van and refrigerated trailers.

stories.title: Mujin Opens M1 Experience Center in Georgia to Showcase AI-Powered Robotic Automation
stories.summary: Mujin Corp. opened its M1 Experience Center in Suwanee, Georgia, on November 5, 2026, to provide manufacturers and warehouse operators with live demonstrations of AI-powered robotic automation. The facility features palletizing, depalletizing, and picking applications powered by MujinOS, allowing visitors to evaluate systems and participate in training programs before committing to deployment.

stories.title: From TractEasy to TLD Robotics: A new chapter in autonomous airport operations
stories.summary: TLD Robotics formally launched in September 2026 following ALVEST Group’s acquisition of EasyMile, consolidating EasyMile, TractEasy, and TLD’s existing driverless vehicle activities. The new company combines autonomous driving technology, vehicle manufacturing, and operational expertise, having completed more than 50,000 autonomous missions across more than 35 sites in 10 countries.

stories.title: Contract Clauses Shield Drone Operators in Plant Inspections
stories.summary: UAV operators and corporate clients are shifting operational risk into Master Service Agreements to mitigate exposures that frequently exceed the total value of inspection contracts. These agreements include waivers of consequential damages, aggregate liability caps, and knock-for-knock indemnities to protect operators from ruinous liability during high-risk infrastructure inspections.

stories.title: Public safety agencies will fly drones over the region after midnight for three nights
stories.summary: Local, state and federal agencies will fly drones across the Washington region between midnight and 4 a.m. on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday to test technology meant to detect and track unauthorized aircraft, the Metropolitan Washington Council of Governments said Monday.

stories.title: Coast Guard concludes seasonal autonomous vessel evaluation on Great Lakes
President Speaks at Kennedy Space Center on Artemis, Supersonic Flight and Planned Annual Cape Canaveral Aerospace Event
stories.summary: The President spoke at NASA's Kennedy Space Center on Nov. 6, 2026, addressing U.S. aerospace leadership, the Artemis program, and commercial supersonic flight. The Department of Transportation announced a proposed noise-based certification rule on June 30, 2026, and the FAA aims to finalize both planned supersonic rules by mid-2027.

stories.title: U.K. shared airspace project advances coordinated drone operations in Chorley
SELF-DRIVING Trucks Are HERE: Venti CEO Reveals US Fleet Operations
stories.summary: Venti Technologies is operating approximately 60 fully autonomous container trucks 24/7 in intermodal yards across California and Texas. The company, which describes its software system as costing roughly $70 million to $80 million, has agreements with several Class I railroads and expects significant rail-yard volume to materialize in two years.

stories.title: Kakao Mobility Bets on Nvidia’s Most Powerful Chips to Win Korea’s Robotaxi Race
stories.summary: Kakao Mobility locked in Nvidia hardware to power its next generation of fully autonomous robotaxis, shifting from cautious testing into a credible race for Level 4 certification. The agreement, formalized at Nvidia AI Day Seoul 2026, pairs dual Nvidia Drive AGX Thor processors with Kakao's proprietary end-to-end AI model and Kia purpose-built vehicles. Seoul has set a target of launching fully unmanned Level 4 robotaxis in its Sangam autonomous driving district starting October 2026.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics adds wheels to Atlas humanoid to test whole-body control
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics released a video showing its Atlas humanoid using wheels to test whole-body control. The company stated the wheeled Atlas is a research testbed, not a product, and Andy Wu, controls engineer for Atlas, attached off-the-shelf scooter rims to the robot's ankles to push actuation limits.

stories.title: Federal Agreement Could Cut Counter-Drone Reviews to 24 Hours
stories.summary: Five federal departments announced a new agreement on November 9 to speed the evaluation and deployment of counter-drone technology while protecting civilian aviation. According to Reuters, FAA official Liam McKenna said the agency has approved more than 1,000 counter-drone coordination requests involving the Pentagon and DHS.

stories.summary: Kongsberg Maritime unveiled the Arctic Hunter, a fully uncrewed surface vessel based on an 184-foot fishing hull, to meet the Royal Navy’s Type 92 requirement for persistent anti-submarine warfare in the High North. The design, announced November 9, integrates Thales Sonar 2087 and aims for 60 days of autonomous operation to expand the fleet’s sensing capacity.

stories.summary: The Finnish Navy announced the formation of an unmanned systems company within its Coastal Brigade starting early next year, following a demonstration of Patria's autonomous air and sea systems in Upinniemi on November 5.

stories.title: Ground Robot Uses Hyperspectral Imaging to Spot Multiple Seed Potato
stories.summary: Agricultural engineers and plant pathologists in the Netherlands evaluated an autonomous field robotics framework that pairs visible to short-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging with machine learning to identify diseased seed potato canopies. The investigation targeted the simultaneous in-field detection of three major potato pathogens: Potato virus Y, Potato leafroll virus, and bacterial blackleg caused by Pectobacterium and Dickeya species.

stories.title: Astrion and Pierce Aerospace Partner to Advance Counter-UAS Capabilities for Homeland Security and Defense Missions
stories.summary: Astrion and Pierce Aerospace announced a strategic partnership to integrate Remote ID technology with mission engineering for counter-unmanned aircraft systems capabilities. The collaboration coincides with the Federal Emergency Management Agency making an additional $250 million available through its fiscal year 2027 Counter-UAS Grant Program, which extends funding to all 56 states and territories.

stories.title: FEMA Urges State and Local Agencies to Act on Counter-Drone Readiness
stories.summary: FEMA Administrator Cameron Hamilton urged state and local agencies to strengthen counter-drone capabilities during a November 9 forum in Maryland. He highlighted a $500 million federal commitment to counter-UAS technology and advised agencies to assess readiness, utilize available grants, and improve communication to address emerging threats.

stories.title: Honda launches $10,000 challenge to improve human-robot collaboration in factories
stories.summary: Honda partnered with Base 11 and Freelancer to launch a $10,000 competition for young Americans to develop ideas for safer human-robot collaboration in manufacturing. The challenge, announced on October 27, invited US residents aged 18 to 26 to propose ways robotics could address workplace hazards or physically demanding tasks.

stories.title: Axon becomes exclusive seller of Skydio drones to police in $1.2B deal
stories.summary: Axon will be the only company selling Skydio drones to public safety agencies in the U.S. and Canada under a $1.2 billion investment. The deal gives Axon roughly 20% more of Skydio on a fully diluted basis at a $5.2 billion pre-money valuation.

Army fields launched effects to 11 of 12 divisions, with Griffon Aerospace delivering the majority
stories.summary: The Army has fielded launched effects to 11 of its 12 headquarters divisions, with Griffon Aerospace supplying the majority of the systems. The service plans to start providing the 12th and final division with launched effects next month.

stories.title: Railway Turnouts Market Forecast to Expand Toward 2035, Driven by High-Speed Rail and Urban Transit Buildouts
stories.summary: IndexBox forecasts the global railway turnouts market will expand steadily from 2026 to 2035, driven by high-speed rail construction in Asia-Pacific and aging asset replacements in North America and Europe. The report attributes this growth to digitalization, predictive maintenance, and decarbonization policies, with Voestalpine Railway Systems and Vossloh AG identified as key participants.

stories.title: Self-Driving and Driver-Assist Crashes: Who Does a Car Accident Lawyer Blame?
stories.summary: A federal jury in Florida found the driver of a Tesla Model S 67 percent at fault and Tesla 33 percent at fault for a fatal 2019 crash, resulting in a $242,570,000 judgment. Tesla appealed the decision, which included $200 million in punitive damages, after the court denied its motion for a new trial.

stories.title: Robotaxi Service Expansion
stories.summary: Amazon announced this spring that Zoox is expanding operations in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with plans to launch in Austin and Miami. Starting in 2027, Zoox will offer rides to and from Grand Prix Plaza in Las Vegas, where riders can access the service via the Zoox app.

also.title: Zoox Steers Into Las Vegas Grand Prix With Multi-Year Robotaxi Deal

stories.title: Russian fiber-optic FPV drone hit Kharkiv, injuring 5 people, including child (Photos)
stories.summary: A Russian fiber-optic first-person view (FPV) drone hit a parking lot in Kharkiv’s Kyivskyi district on Nov. 9, injuring five people, including a one-year-old boy who is now in intensive care, according to Kharkiv oblast governor Oleh Syniehubov.

stories.title: Portuguese drone maker Tekever expands into Denmark
stories.summary: Tekever announced on November 6 that it is expanding into Denmark with a new presence in Odense, supported by an investment commitment from EIFO. The company is targeting approximately $580 million in a Series D fundraising round with an indicated valuation of $6.4 billion, aiming to develop operations in stages subject to demand and approvals.

stories.title: US federal agencies expand joint effort to counter drone threats, protect airspace
stories.summary: Five US federal departments announced Monday an expanded joint effort to counter drone threats and protect civilian aviation. The initiative, led by the White House Task Force to Restore American Airspace Sovereignty, establishes a coordinated process for evaluating and deploying counter-drone technologies to protect US airspace and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin Calls for More Affordable, Effective Counter-Drone Technology
stories.summary: Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin called for more affordable counter-drone technology on November 9, citing the inefficiency of using a $40,000 missile to intercept a $20 drone. He suggested leasing arrangements to help state, local, tribal, and territorial agencies afford equipment and noted that current federal law limits who can use certain mitigation technologies.

stories.title: Drone kills worker at Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhya nuclear plant
stories.summary: The plant's management and the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) said on Monday that a worker at the Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhya nuclear power plant in Ukraine was killed in a drone attack. The Russian-controlled plant management blamed Ukraine for the man's death, stating his car was hit by a drone on his way to work.

stories.title: Op-ed: California High Speed Rail still needs to happen
stories.summary: The California High Speed Rail authority's chief executive officer resigned after hired consultants misused taxpayer dollars for luxurious trips, a scandal that has compounded the project's delays and cost overruns. The line's completion date has slipped from 2020 to 2039, with estimated costs rising from $33.5 billion to $230 billion, while the authority faces potential funding exhaustion as early as next year following federal cuts of up to $4 billion.

stories.title: Japan to provide radar system and UAVs to Philippine military
stories.summary: Japan will provide a coastal radar system and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to the Philippine military under a $27 million agreement signed in Manila. The transfer marks the first delivery of completed Japanese-made defense equipment under Tokyo’s 2023 Official Security Assistance program.

stories.title: Ukraine Drone Forces Shift to Starlink Alternative for Comms to Hit Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine’s long-range drone forces are shifting to Israeli-Italian HiSKY satellite links to replace Starlink, which Elon Musk’s SpaceX restricted over Russia. Russian analysts claim the new system allows unjammable swarm attacks on oil refineries, though Ukrainian officials have not confirmed the adoption.

stories.title: French company NXT LVL Naval unveils NXT U15 oceangoing USV amid global shift toward unmanned naval warfare
stories.summary: French company NXT LVL Naval unveiled the NXT U15, a 15-meter oceangoing unmanned surface vessel concept, at Euronaval 2026 in Paris. The modular platform is designed for maritime surveillance, mine countermeasures, and logistics without crew quarters, aligning with France's June 2026 naval drone roadmap.

stories.title: Neros to expand domestic drone production with $450M Pentagon loan
stories.summary: Neros Technologies received a $450 million conditional loan from the Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital to expand domestic manufacturing of small drone components. The company will commit an additional $165 million, bringing total investment to $615 million, with plans to produce 80% of drone value in-house by late next year.

stories.title: Intel and SAP demonstrate AI-powered autonomous warehouse system
stories.summary: Intel and SAP announced a proof-of-concept system on October 27 that connects SAP Extended Warehouse Management with Intel’s edge AI hardware to coordinate autonomous mobile robots. The demonstration showed shorter transport distances and reduced manual handling, with the companies intending to develop the approach into a repeatable framework for multiple facilities.

stories.title: Eve Air Mobility signs binding order for up to 12 eVTOL aircraft with Brazil’s FlyBIS
stories.summary: Eve Air Mobility and FlyBIS Aviation signed a binding agreement for up to 12 eVTOL aircraft, converting a 2022 letter of intent. The deal comprises two firm orders and purchase rights for 10 additional units, with FlyBIS planning deployment in southern Brazil.

stories.title: China tests next-generation stealth drone operations aboard 40,000-ton warship
stories.summary: The GJ-21 stealth unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) successfully completed takeoff and landing operations aboard the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan. The GJ-21 relies on intelligent control and automated assistance systems to coordinate its movements with the ship.

stories.title: Railway Digitalization Calls for Stronger Cybersecurity in Mexico
stories.summary: Siemens Mobility and SONDA announced a March 2026 contract to develop signaling and control solutions for the Mexico City-Queretaro-Irapuato corridor, spanning more than 300 kilometers. The project includes advanced railway technology, although it does not provide evidence of a specific implementation of obstacle-detection cameras at level crossings.

stories.title: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after software fix, feds say
stories.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened a new investigation into Waymo after a majority of reported incidents involving robotaxis illegally passing stopped school buses occurred after the company deployed a software update intended to fix the problem. The agency's Office of Defects Investigation is assessing the adequacy of the remedy following reports of at least five such incidents in Austin.

stories.summary: ABB Robotics launched AI Robot Trainer to expand OmniCore EyeMotion, enabling customers to train and deploy AI-powered robot vision applications without building models from scratch. The integrated solution reduces commissioning time by up to 90 percent and cycle time by up to 50 percent while supporting vision applications from 2D pick and place to 3D bin picking.

stories.summary: Tesla extended Robotaxi operating hours to 5 a.m. to 2 a.m. in Austin, Dallas, and Tampa, leaving a three-hour overnight break. This change follows a recent expansion to 20 hours of daily service.

stories.summary: Volkswagen is developing a shared artificial intelligence data platform with Porsche, Voxel51, Microsoft, and Nvidia to accelerate autonomous vehicle development. Announced at Nvidia GTC Berlin on October 21, the initiative aims to reduce repeated physical test drives by up to 90 percent and shorten AI regression testing cycles by up to 85 percent.

stories.title: Czech critical infrastructure operators could get new powers to counter drone breaches
stories.summary: The Czech government approved proposals to grant critical infrastructure operators the right to eliminate uncooperative drones entering no-fly areas. The measures, which require parliamentary backing, aim to enable a swift and proportionate response to protect energy and transport facilities.

stories.title: Amtrak, VIA Rail Open Modernized Maintenance Facilities for New Fleets
stories.summary: Amtrak and VIA Rail Canada completed major maintenance facility projects to support their next-generation trainsets. Amtrak's new $250 million Seattle facility, delivered $50 million under budget, supports the Airo fleet and will open in phases through the end of 2026, while VIA Rail's modernized Toronto center supports 32 new Corridor trainsets and is expected to sustain nearly 240 permanent jobs.

stories.title: UK-built strike drones launch from HMS Queen Elizabeth as hybrid air wing takes shape
stories.summary: BAE Systems' Callen-Lenz launched four Nyan strike drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth in October, with all four hitting designated strike points during Exercise Neptune Reach B. The trials, part of Project Vantage, assessed how uncrewed systems could operate alongside F-35B aircraft to extend the carrier force's reach and provide additional strike options.

stories.summary: Five autonomous vehicles arrived at Fort Benning Nov. 4 for the Robotic Operations for Autonomous Delivery and Sustainment (ROADS) prize challenge, a pilot initiative executed in partnership with the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) to evaluate commercial self-driving technology on military installations.

Tessera Subsidiary Zorronet Expands EU Drone-Security Push
stories.summary: Tessera Defense and Homeland Security said on November 9, 2026 that its Israeli subsidiary Zorronet has widened its partnership with Czech firm D4P group. The deal now covers AI-based drone detection and critical infrastructure protection across the European Union, beyond farming and transport.

stories.summary: Tesla launched its Robotaxi service in San Antonio, its eighth city, with a launch geofence covering about 274 square miles. The service began at 5am local time, though independent checks in other cities suggest the actual bookable area may be significantly smaller than advertised.

stories.summary: Kodiak AI signed an agreement to place its autonomous driving system in 75 trucks owned by DTL Transport, while Aurora Innovation secured a commitment from Charger Logistics to deploy up to 500 trucks. The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration approved a five-year exemption through October 2031 allowing qualifying Level 4 operators to use cab-mounted warning beacons instead of traditional roadside devices.

stories.title: How TÜV SÜD & Accenture are Simulating Robot Safety Checks
stories.summary: TÜV SÜD and Accenture presented a Physical AI Safety Suite at NVIDIA GTC Berlin in October that uses digital twins and simulations to prepare autonomous mobile robot certification. TÜV SÜD estimates the process could bring production online up to 30% sooner, while Patrick Vollmer stated on-site inspection remains essential to check real sensor performance and hardware tolerances.

stories.title: Contested Skies: What a Recent Military Operation with Mexico Reveals About the Homeland Drone Fight
stories.summary: The United States allowed Mexico to procure advanced counter-drone technology directly from the U.S. Army’s digital marketplace to increase Mexico’s counter-drone capacity. This occurred during Operation High Eagle, a bilateral counter-drone mission recently concluded by U.S. and Mexican authorities along the southwest border.

stories.title: Europe’s uncrewed airspace: what is really holding back U-space?
stories.summary: The European Commission published Implementing Regulation 2021/664 in 2021 to establish the legal framework for U-space, with rules becoming applicable on 26 January 2023. While U1 and parts of U2 are live in pockets, full implementation of U3 and U4 remains largely theoretical due to commercial, technical, and bureaucratic barriers.

stories.title: CoreWeave Expands Into ‘Physical AI’ With Wayve Driverless-Car Deal, But CRWV Stock On Track To Fresh 18-Month Low
stories.summary: CoreWeave signed a multi-year deal to provide Nvidia Blackwell-powered cloud infrastructure to Wayve for training self-driving AI models, though the company did not disclose financial terms. The announcement failed to lift CoreWeave shares, which fell around 3% in pre-market trading and trended toward a fresh 18-month low.

stories.title: Tesla’s Robotaxi arrives in Orlando, but there’s a catch for visitors
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Robotaxi service to Orlando in July, adding the city to its existing network in Austin, Dallas, Houston, and Miami. The service remains limited to a select area north of Orlando International Airport while Tesla continues safety testing and gradually expands coverage.

AI agents test and improve robot code in virtual worlds before deployment
stories.summary: Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist, is presenting "agentic robotics" at the Conference on Robot Learning, an approach that uses AI agents to generate, test, and refine robot code in NVIDIA's Isaac simulation before deployment. The team is also releasing open-source code and an industry-standard benchmark for evaluating robot performance across industrial tasks.

stories.title: RIA Extends Remit to Include Republic of Ireland
stories.summary: The Railway Industry Association (RIA) voted to extend its remit to include the Republic of Ireland, a decision approved at its Annual General Meeting on 4 November. The association will increase its Business Engagement Manager resource to cover the whole island of Ireland, commencing in January 2027 ahead of its All-Island Rail Summit scheduled for 10 February 2027 in Dublin.

stories.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a ‘paradigm shift’ for robotics
Pune Metro Line 3 Enters Service with Alstom and Siemens Technology
stories.summary: Pune Metro Line 3 entered passenger service on 4 November 2026, connecting Hinjewadi and Shivajinagar via a 23.3 km elevated route with 23 stations. Alstom supplied 22 Metropolis trainsets, while Siemens provided signalling and electrification systems, aiming to reduce journey times by up to 50%.

stories.title: UK CAA contemplates new UAS advisory panel
stories.summary: The UK Civil Aviation Authority is seeking views on establishing Stakeholder Advisory Bodies to improve engagement with industry and stakeholders. Subject to feedback, the CAA says an advisory panel on uncrewed aerial systems could be established in the next two years, with the first panels provisionally meeting from next summer.

stories.title: Singapore suspends some autonomous vehicle tests — Channel NewsAsia
stories.summary: Singapore's Land Transport Authority suspended some autonomous vehicle trials in Punggol after two dangerous incidents on November 5. Grab was ordered to stop testing at specific intersections, while ComfortDelGro was temporarily barred from making U-turns at the Punggol Field intersection.

stories.title: Tesla Closes in on Waymo’s Texas Robotaxi Fleet with 1,282 Vehicles
stories.summary: Tesla added 78 vehicles to its Texas automated vehicle registry since November 1, reaching 1,282 vehicles, while Waymo added 26 to reach 1,285. The Texas DMV registry tracks vehicles authorized for autonomous operations under Senate Bill 2807, not necessarily those actively transporting paying passengers.

stories.title: Perspective: From proving autonomy works to proving it scales
stories.summary: Kazmi, chief product officer for Volvo Autonomous Solutions, argues that autonomous trucking is shifting from proving driverless capability to demonstrating safe, predictable commercial operations. He states that scaling requires purpose-built trucks with integrated redundancy across braking, steering, power, and computing systems to ensure reliable uptime under real freight conditions.

stories.title: 60 driverless electric haul trucks operating at 5,400 metres above sea level
stories.summary: EACON Mining and Julong Copper have achieved fully autonomous standard operation for 60 battery-electric haul trucks at the Zhibula copper mine in China. The fleet operates at an altitude of over 5,400 meters, reducing the need for drivers by around 80 per cent and saving an estimated 12,000 tonnes of CO₂ annually.

stories.title: NASA SPLICE Passes Alta-X Landing Test Aug. 27 [2026]
stories.summary: NASA announced on November 4, 2026, that its Safe and Precise Landing – Integrated Capabilities Evolution (SPLICE) payload passed a key test on August 27, 2026. The system flew simulated lunar descent maneuvers on an Alta-X drone over Rogers Dry Lake near NASA’s Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, validating guidance and navigation for future robotic and crewed lunar and Martian missions.

AirData and Pilot Institute Integrate Drone Pilot Training Records into UAS Operations
stories.summary: AirData UAV and Pilot Institute announced an integration that automatically synchronizes drone pilot training certificates and skills with AirData’s fleet management platform. The feature, available across all AirData subscription levels including free accounts, imports Pilot Institute credentials directly into the system to reduce manual recordkeeping for commercial operators.

stories.title: Rail Vision’s Quantum Platform Launches End-to-End Quantum Error Correction Program at the Israeli Quantum Computing Center
stories.summary: Rail Vision's subsidiary Quantum Transportation launched an end-to-end quantum error correction program on the Arbel superconducting quantum processor at the Israeli Quantum Computing Center. The company stated the initial experiments establish a foundation for a unified workflow connecting device characterization, circuit execution, and error decoding, with the next phase focusing on incorporating a noise-aware decoder into the operational workflow.

stories.title: New Gas Turbine Will Keep AI Cool Before It Gets to Power Supersonic Passenger Plane
stories.summary: Boom Supersonic completed its first Sprint Core turbine prototype and moved it to its test site at Colorado Air and Space Port in Watkins, Colorado. The company plans to use the hardware to calibrate engineering tools at its Superfactory in Centennial, South Denver area, and optimize production of its 42-megawatt Superpower natural gas turbine for AI data centers.

stories.title: BNSF Q3 earnings climb 19.3% as rail freight volumes rise
stories.summary: BNSF reported third-quarter net earnings of $1.73 billion, a 19.3% increase from $1.45 billion in the prior year, as higher freight volumes and operating efficiencies offset increased fuel costs. Railroad operating revenue climbed 14.7% to $6.87 billion, while car and unit volumes rose 3.9% for the period ended Sept. 30.

stories.title: Lewisville Police Drones Flew 1,789 Times. Public Log Shows 1,303
stories.summary: The Lewisville Police Department reported 1,789 drone flights between Jan. 1 and Nov. 3, but its public dashboard listed only 1,303 flights, with the last entry dated Sept. 2. The department operates 19 Skydio drones under FAA authorization for beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights, and Police Chief Brook Rollins promised a public-facing transparency portal at the May 8 launch.

Republic of Korea restructures its UAM project
stories.summary: The Republic of Korea’s Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) is launching the Neo K-UAM Grand Challenge (Neo GC) this week to prepare for the introduction of Urban Air Mobility (UAM) services. A briefing session for interested local governments, companies and organisations will be held in Seoul on 10 November.

stories.title: Egypt’s X-GEN Targets USD 92.3M in Investments to Expand Local Drone and Robot Manufacturing
stories.summary: Egypt’s X-GEN is targeting a fivefold increase in investments to approximately EGP 5 billion (USD 92.3M) over the next three years to localise drone and robotics manufacturing. The company is pursuing technology transfer partnerships with entities in China, France, and Saudi Arabia to integrate locally manufactured components into imported systems.

stories.title: Russia Sends a 1960s MT-LB Into Battle With Anti-Drone Armor—Ukraine Destroys It Anyway
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Ares Unmanned Systems Battalion destroyed a Russian MT-LB armored vehicle carrying infantry, stopping the unit’s attempted advance, according to ArmyInform on November 9. Ukrainian drone operators tracked the vehicle, which featured additional anti-drone protection, and struck it with a precise aerial attack.

stories.title: Interview: Uganda Railways focuses on rolling stock and network renewal
stories.summary: Uganda Railways Corp is procuring new rolling stock to renew its aging fleet, Chief Mechanical Engineer Prosper Musiime tells Railway Gazette International.

stories.title: Colombia Blames ELN for Drone Strike a Week After US Reapers Debut
stories.summary: Defense Minister Jorge Mora blamed the ELN for a drone strike on Saturday, November 7, that killed three soldiers and seriously wounded 16 at the Colombian Army’s compound in Santa Rosa del Sur. The attack followed the arrest of Leivis Enrique Valero Castillo, whom the government accuses of financing the ELN’s Guamocó Resistance Front.

stories.title: Russian FPV Drone Strike Injures 3 Ukrenergo Workers in Sumy
stories.summary: A Russian first-person view (FPV) drone struck a vehicle carrying Ukrenergo employees in Sumy on Nov. 9, injuring three workers. One victim underwent surgery for severe injuries, while Ukrenergo stated Russia deliberately targets grid personnel.

stories.title: Train collision in Egypt kills 7 and injures 125 near Cairo
stories.summary: A Giza–Fayoum train struck a stationary Cairo–Aswan train in Al-Ayyat, south of Cairo, killing seven people and injuring 125 on Sunday. Egyptian National Railways (ENR) said the crash occurred between Kafr Ammar and El Raqqa stations, with several cars coming off the rails. President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi ordered a prompt investigation, and a specialized technical committee is examining the site to determine the technical reasons for the collision.

stories.title: Pakistan’s Arrow and Lightning Drones Signal a New Air Defence Challenge for India
stories.summary: Images circulating on 9 November 2026 show Arrow-I, Lightning-I and Lightning-II drone models at Pakistan’s National Aerospace Science and Technology Park (NASTP), pointing to additions to a one-way strike portfolio tested in the May 2025 conflict with India.

stories.title: Fire Erupts at Kirishi Refinery After 81 Drones Reported Over Leningrad Region
stories.summary: Local authorities confirmed drone impacts in the industrial zone of Kirishi after 81 enemy UAVs were shot down over the Leningrad region on November 9. A fire broke out at the Kirishinefteorgsintez refinery, and debris struck an apartment, forcing one family to evacuate.

stories.title: EOS to supply MARSS NiDAR to Middle East
stories.summary: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited (EOS) secured a USD 16 million order for counter-uncrewed aerial systems capabilities from an undisclosed Middle Eastern nation state. The contract, the first sale by EOS or MARSS to the country, includes sensor systems, soft-kill effectors, and command facilities centered on the MARSS NiDAR C2 system, with substantial fulfillment expected within the next 12 months.

stories.title: Uber robotaxi expansion: 2026–27 targets and plans
stories.summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi forecast about 700 robotaxis on the platform by the end of 2026 and more than 2,000 in 2027. The company plans a driverless Zoox launch in Las Vegas later in November 2026, followed by commercial service in the San Francisco Bay Area early in 2027.

stories.title: UK port to deploy autonomous electric shuttle
stories.summary: Portsmouth International Port will deploy Aurrigo International's electric Auto-Shuttle later this month to demonstrate driverless technology in a live, mixed-traffic environment. Backed by up to £100,000 from the Freight Innovation Fund, the vehicle will transport people, baggage, and freight on a 1km journey, beginning with empty runs to map the area.

stories.title: US Army evaluates the FD-1 interceptor’s C-UAS capabilities in Europe
stories.summary: The United States Army conducted an internal assessment of the FD-1 interceptor’s counter-uncrewed aerial systems capabilities at the Ustka Training Area in Poland from 2-6 November. Operation Audacious Fury aimed to establish cost-effective, lower-tier kinetic magazine depth against Group 1–3 and massed UAS threats.

UBTECH Partners with Tianyi to Scale Humanoid Robot Adoption
stories.summary: UBTECH and Tianyi Telecom Terminal signed a strategic cooperation agreement on November 9, 2026, aiming to help the household-companion robot-terminal industry exceed one million units within three years. The partnership also targets more than 100,000 ultra-bionic humanoid and wheeled humanoid terminals, combining China Telecom’s channel network with UBTECH’s robot technology.

stories.title: Royal Navy launches first drone boat squadron
stories.summary: The Royal Navy commissioned its first unmanned boat squadron at Portsmouth Naval Base on November 5, a £12m unit designed to monitor Russian vessels. The remotely controlled 28ft boats, which can travel at speeds of up to 63mph, are part of a £1.5bn investment to create a 'hybrid navy' integrating autonomous technology with traditional warships.

stories.title: Appetronix brings robotic dining to airports
stories.summary: Appetronix launched Donatos by Appetronix, a fully autonomous restaurant at John Glenn Columbus International Airport that uses robotic food preparation and heated pickup lockers to serve travelers around the clock. The company was selected as one of 10 Automated Retail & Kiosk Innovation Award winners for 2026, with winners to be honored at the show in Miami Beach from Dec. 14-16.

stories.title: Weekly Recap: V2X raises guidance and Tempest counter-drone growth
stories.summary: V2X Inc reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.27 billion and adjusted EPS of $1.64, raising its full-year guidance. The company’s Tempest counter-drone system grew from one customer to five and completed over 1,000 engagements in under 18 months.

stories.title: CSG to support the implementation of U-space in Czech airspace
stories.summary: CSG delivered a Common Information Service system to Air Navigation Services of the Czech Republic to support U-space implementation, with full deployment expected in the second half of 2027. The system enables safe coordination of drones with other airspace users by distributing geographical restrictions, flight authorizations, and real-time tracking data.

stories.title: West Valley Votes on Free Police Drone Trial With $874,985 Renewal
stories.summary: The West Valley City Council votes Tuesday, November 10, on a deal with Motorola Solutions that would give the Utah city’s police department three BRINC drones for a year at no cost. The package covers a docked drone dispatched directly to calls, a tactical drone officers launch from their vehicles, and a small indoor drone for SWAT work.

stories.title: US Air Force seeks anti-drone nets for F-35 shelters at Tyndall
stories.summary: The US Air Force published a notice on SAM.gov on November 6, 2026, seeking contractors to design and install counter-unmanned aircraft system netting on six F-35A parking shelters at Tyndall Air Force Base, Florida. The netting must stop Group 1 drones weighing up to approximately nine kilograms (20 pounds) and withstand temperatures of up to 204 degrees Celsius (400 degrees Fahrenheit). This market research effort does not commit the service to a purchase.

stories.title: Sri Lanka plans first commercial eVTOL operations with EHang “in the next two to three months”
stories.summary: Sri Lanka plans to launch commercial eVTOL passenger flights within the next two to three months, subject to successful initial flight trials scheduled for November 11, according to Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation Anura Karunatilake. Chinese aviation technology company EHang is leading the project, while the Sri Lankan government is providing policy support, infrastructure assistance and the necessary regulatory approvals.

stories.title: Russian Armored Vehicles Challenge Ukraine's FPV Drones
stories.summary: Ukraine's 237th Unmanned Systems Battalion began deploying Fire Point FP-1 drones to counter Russian armored vehicles equipped with protective structures that withstand repeated FPV drone strikes. The shift increases costs from approximately $500 for small FPV drones to as much as $50,000 for FP-1 systems, which can carry warheads weighing up to 158 kilograms.

stories.title: NATO Counter-Drone Catalog: 2024 Startup Says It Won 6 of 16 Lots
stories.summary: NATO opened its counter-drone marketplace on November 5, listing 16 systems from five companies that Allies can buy without running a tender of their own. Alta Ares, a French company founded in 2024, says it won six of the 16 lots, more than any other supplier.

stories.title: Florida university selects electric eVTOL for police patrol role
stories.summary: Florida Polytechnic University in Lakeland, Florida, introduced a Jetson ONE electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft for evaluation in law enforcement operations. The university intends to assess the aircraft for campus patrols and emergency supplies, with police officers receiving pilot training.

stories.title: Russian Geran-5 drone operates like miniature cruise missile — HUR
stories.summary: Ukrainian Military Intelligence reported on Nov. 9 that Russia upgraded its Geran-5 drone into a compact cruise missile reaching speeds up to 1,000 km/h. The K5-K variant measures 4 meters in length, carries a 90-kilogram warhead, and uses a TRD-200 micro-turbojet engine assembled in Tatarstan.

stories.title: New wheeled humanoid robot learns factory jobs in a month, reports 95% success rate
stories.summary: Swiss startup Embodied AI unveiled AIR, a wheeled, two-armed robot that learns factory tasks through remote operation and aims for autonomy within a month. The company reported a 95 percent task success rate in paid pilots and said AIR can handle the workload of up to three workers per shift.

US Department of War to Test Mobile Factories for Drone Airframes
stories.summary: Machina Labs was selected under the US Department of War’s Organic Industrial Base Modernization Challenge to develop and qualify a metal airframe for the Low-Cost Uncrewed Combat Attack System (LUCAS) class. Machina Bellator will lead development and qualification in Los Angeles, while each pilot site will start with a containerized robotic manufacturing cell.

stories.title: Russia strikes Ukraine with 317 drones: Hits recorded at 30 locations
stories.summary: Russian forces attacked Ukraine overnight into Nov. 9 with 317 strike drones, hitting 31 locations and injuring seven people in Kremenchuk. Air defenses shot down or suppressed 271 Shahed-type drones, while Odesa Oblast suffered energy system damage that DTEK Odesa Grids is working to repair.

stories.title: Shield raises $2.5 billion to finance major Echodyne acquisition
stories.summary: Shield announced a $5.3 billion agreement to acquire radar manufacturer Echodyne, planning to raise $2.5 billion to support the transaction. The deal is expected to close in early 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

stories.title: Oshkosh Defense to produce Grid Aero's Lifter long-range cargo drone to improve US military logistics
stories.summary: Oshkosh Defense partnered with Grid Aero on November 2, 2026, to manufacture the Lifter autonomous cargo drone in Wisconsin, marking Oshkosh’s first entry into aircraft production. The initial Lifter Lite targets a 2,000-lb payload over 2,000 nautical miles, with a pilot line targeted for late 2027 to support U.S. military logistics in the Indo-Pacific.
